title: Image-Based Deep Learning Detection of High-Grade B-Cell Lymphomas Directly from Hematoxylin and Eosin Images
summary: Self-supervised histology foundation model plus MIL classified DHL/THL from H&E; blinded independent 25-case FISH validation (10 positives) showed 100% sensitivity, 86.7% specificity, AUC .95. Small single-center retrospective proof of concept; broader validation required.
